value.answer: Oakville doesn't have an open Costco yet. The closest ones are in Burlington, at 1225 Brant St, and Mississauga, at 3180 Laird Rd. I don't have drive times, so I can't say which of the two is nearer you. The first Oakville warehouse, on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive, is due to open in fall 2027.
